full_judgment: Md Ruhul Amin J: This appeal by leave is against the judgment and order dated August 7, 2001 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Rule No. 800 (condonation) of 2000 discharging the Rule which was obtained upon an application filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act seeking condonation of delay in filing revisional application against the judgment and decree dated November 18, 1998 of the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge), and 2nd Commercial Court and Artha Rin Adalat No. 2, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 118 of 1997 affirming the judgment and decree dated April 16, 1997 of the 2nd Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 191 of 1996 decreeing the same. The suit has been filed seeking declaration of title and for further reliefs that the plaintiff-respondent Nos. 1-19 are entitled to get the property described in the schedule attached to the plaint released from acquisition and the Housing and Settlement Department is not entitled to sell the property in suit to anybody.
